translations.web: For Yahweh says, “The whole land will be a desolation; yet I will not make a full end.
translations.bsb: For this is what the LORD says: “The whole land will be desolate, but I will not finish its destruction.
translations.kjv: For thus hath the LORD said, The whole land shall be desolate; yet will I not make a full end.
translations.asv: For thus saith Jehovah, The whole land shall be a desolation; yet will I not make a full end.
